pulse: NQ gapping up ~3.4% premarket on an oversold bounce after the Nasdaq's worst week since 2020, led by NVDA +8% as Trump pushes for Huang's return; offset by Iran blockade threats, JPM turning cautious and CRWD -8% on its $43.9B ZS deal.
bias: mixed — risk-on gap (NQ +3.4%, ES +2.7%, NVDA +8% pre, oil < $83) after a -10% week, but bounce is fragile: JPM desk warns rally may not last, Iran threatens 'all available means' vs US blockade, and Trump says the slide 'will only get worse'; thin Thanksgiving week
